note: Applied previously proposed repairs via native reconcileExtractionAfterRepairs. Author cannot approve editorial-decisions.

proposals.before: Liu Yi seized Huan Xuan’s adherents—Bian Fanzhi, Yang Shoushou, Xiahou Chongzhi, Huan Daogong, and the rest—and had every one of them executed.
proposals.after: Liu Yi seized Huan Xuan’s adherents—Bian Fanzhi, Yang Sengshou, Xiahou Chongzhi, Huan Daogong, and the rest—and had every one of them executed.
proposals.reason: 羊僧壽 is read Yang Sengshou (僧 seng), not Shoushou.

proposals.before: Yi seized Huan Xuan’s partisans Bian Fanzhi, Yang Shoushou, Xia Hou Chongzhi, Huan Daogong, and others, and all were beheaded.
proposals.after: Yi seized Huan Xuan’s partisans Bian Fanzhi, Yang Sengshou, Xiahou Chongzhi, Huan Daogong, and others, and all were beheaded.
proposals.reason: 羊僧壽 is read Yang Sengshou (僧 seng); 夏侯 is the single compound surname Xiahou.

proposals.before: His uncle Zhen had been Left Household Grandee of Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.
proposals.after: His uncle Zhen had been Left Household Grandee.
proposals.reason: 左光祿大夫 is the left household grandee; the text has no 金紫 (golden seal and purple ribbon).

proposals.before: His uncle Liu Zhen had held the post of left household grandee with the golden seal and purple ribbon.
proposals.after: His uncle Liu Zhen had held the post of left household grandee.
proposals.reason: 左光祿大夫 is the left household grandee; the text has no 金紫 (golden seal and purple ribbon).

proposals.before: He Mai’s courtesy name was Boqun.
proposals.after: Liu Mai’s courtesy name was Boqun.
proposals.reason: 邁 here is Liu Yi's elder brother Liu Mai (劉邁), not a man surnamed He.

proposals.before: He Mai, still seated among the guests, told Huan Xuan, “You have plenty of horsemanship and spearplay; you lack any finer sense of what is fitting.”
proposals.after: Liu Mai, still seated among the guests, told Huan Xuan, “You have plenty of horsemanship and spearplay; you lack any finer sense of what is fitting.”
proposals.reason: 邁 here is Liu Yi's elder brother Liu Mai (劉邁), not a man surnamed He.

proposals.before: Yin Zhongkan went pale. After Huan Xuan left he said to He Mai, “You are insane!
proposals.after: Yin Zhongkan went pale. After Huan Xuan left he said to Liu Mai, “You are insane!
proposals.reason: 邁 here is Liu Yi's elder brother Liu Mai (劉邁), not a man surnamed He.

proposals.before: He Mai answered with blunt reproof and never thought himself in the wrong.
proposals.after: Liu Mai answered with blunt reproof and never thought himself in the wrong.
proposals.reason: 邁 here is Liu Yi's elder brother Liu Mai (劉邁), not a man surnamed He.

proposals.before: Huan Xuan did send pursuers; He Mai only barely escaped.
proposals.after: Huan Xuan did send pursuers; Liu Mai only barely escaped.
proposals.reason: 邁 here is Liu Yi's elder brother Liu Mai (劉邁), not a man surnamed He.

proposals.before: Later, when Huan Xuan had seized power, He Mai presented himself at the gate. Huan Xuan asked, “What made you so sure you would live to face me again?”
proposals.after: Later, when Huan Xuan had seized power, Liu Mai presented himself at the gate. Huan Xuan asked, “What made you so sure you would live to face me again?”
proposals.reason: 邁 here is Liu Yi's elder brother Liu Mai (劉邁), not a man surnamed He.

proposals.before: He Mai replied, “There is the lord who forgave the archer of the belt-hook, the lord who spared the sleeve-cutter, and myself—three who ought to have died yet lived. I knew I would be the third.”
proposals.after: Liu Mai replied, “There is the lord who forgave the archer of the belt-hook, the lord who spared the sleeve-cutter, and myself—three who ought to have died yet lived. I knew I would be the third.”
proposals.reason: 邁 here is Liu Yi's elder brother Liu Mai (劉邁), not a man surnamed He.

proposals.before: When Liu Yi and Liu Yu plotted the loyal rising, He Mai meant to join them; word slipped out and Huan Xuan had him killed.
proposals.after: When Liu Yi and Liu Yu plotted the loyal rising, Liu Mai meant to join them; word slipped out and Huan Xuan had him killed.
proposals.reason: 邁 here is Liu Yi's elder brother Liu Mai (劉邁), not a man surnamed He.

proposals.before: Five orphaned nephews of his cousin Tan Shao were still children; he reared them as his own sons.
proposals.after: His elder cousin's five sons, Tan Shao and his brothers, were orphaned children; he reared them as his own sons.
proposals.reason: 從兄子韶兄弟五人 means Tan Shao and his brothers were the sons of Tan Pingzhi's elder cousin, not the cousin himself.
